<?php

namespace App\Services;

use App\Contracts\StorageInterface;
use App\Contracts\EncryptionInterface;

class PdfGenerationService
{
    private StorageInterface $storage;
    private EncryptionInterface $encryption;
    private string $tempDir;
    private array $activeJobs = [];

    public function __construct(
        StorageInterface $storage,
        EncryptionInterface $encryption,
        string $tempDir = '/tmp/pdf-gen'
    ) {
        $this->storage = $storage;
        $this->encryption = $encryption;
        $this->tempDir = $tempDir;
        if (!is_dir($this->tempDir)) {
            mkdir($this->tempDir, 0700, true);
        }
    }

    public function generateAndStore(string $jobId, string $htmlContent, string $userId): array
    {
        $sanitizedHtml = $this->sanitizeHtml($htmlContent);
        $lockFile = $this->acquireJobLock($jobId, $userId);
        
        try {
            $pdfContent = $this->renderPdf($sanitizedHtml);
            $encryptedPath = $this->encryptAndWrite($jobId, $pdfContent, $userId);
            $this->finalizeJob($jobId, $encryptedPath, $userId);
            
            return ['status' => 'success', 'path' => $encryptedPath, 'job_id' => $jobId];
        } finally {
            $this->releaseJobLock($lockFile);
        }
    }

    private function acquireJobLock(string $jobId, string $userId): string
    {
        $lockPath = $this->tempDir . '/' . hash('sha256', $jobId) . '.lock';
        $attempts = 0;
        
        while ($attempts < 50) {
            $fp = @fopen($lockPath, 'x');
            if ($fp !== false) {
                fwrite($fp, json_encode(['user' => $userId, 'time' => microtime(true)]));
                fclose($fp);
                return $lockPath;
            }
            
            // Check if existing lock is stale (older than 30 seconds)
            if (file_exists($lockPath)) {
                $stat = stat($lockPath);
                if ($stat && (time() - $stat['mtime']) > 30) {
                    // Re-check with flock to prevent race on stale lock removal
                    $lfp = @fopen($lockPath, 'r');
                    if ($lfp !== false) {
                        if (flock($lfp, LOCK_EX | LOCK_NB)) {
                            $lockData = json_decode(stream_get_contents($lfp), true);
                            if ($lockData && (microtime(true) - $lockData['time']) > 30.0) {
                                flock($lfp, LOCK_UN);
                                fclose($lfp);
                                unlink($lockPath);
                                continue;
                            }
                            flock($lfp, LOCK_UN);
                        }
                        fclose($lfp);
                    }
                }
            }
            
            usleep(100000); // 100ms
            $attempts++;
        }
        
        throw new \RuntimeException('Could not acquire job lock');
    }

    private function releaseJobLock(string $lockPath): void
    {
        if (file_exists($lockPath)) {
            unlink($lockPath);
        }
    }

    private function renderPdf(string $html): string
    {
        $tempHtml = tempnam($this->tempDir, 'html_');
        $tempPdf = tempnam($this->tempDir, 'pdf_');
        
        file_put_contents($tempHtml, $html);
        
        $escapedHtml = escapeshellarg($tempHtml);
        $escapedPdf = escapeshellarg($tempPdf);
        
        exec("wkhtmltopdf --quiet {$escapedHtml} {$escapedPdf} 2>/dev/null", $output, $returnCode);
        
        if ($returnCode !== 0) {
            @unlink($tempHtml);
            @unlink($tempPdf);
            throw new \RuntimeException('PDF generation failed');
        }
        
        $pdfContent = file_get_contents($tempPdf);
        @unlink($tempHtml);
        @unlink($tempPdf);
        
        return $pdfContent;
    }

    private function encryptAndWrite(string $jobId, string $pdfContent, string $userId): string
    {
        $derivedKey = $this->deriveStorageKey($jobId, $userId);
        $encryptedContent = $this->encryption->encrypt($pdfContent, $derivedKey);
        
        $storagePath = $this->buildStoragePath($jobId, $userId);
        
        // Write to temporary location first, then move atomically
        $tempPath = $storagePath . '.tmp.' . getmypid();
        $this->storage->write($tempPath, $encryptedContent);
        
        // Verify written content integrity before finalizing (constant-time)
        $verification = $this->storage->read($tempPath);
        if (!hash_equals(hash('sha256', $encryptedContent), hash('sha256', $verification))) {
            $this->storage->delete($tempPath);
            throw new \RuntimeException('Storage integrity check failed');
        }
        
        $this->storage->move($tempPath, $storagePath);
        
        return $storagePath;
    }

    private function deriveStorageKey(string $jobId, string $userId): string
    {
        $masterKey = $this->encryption->getMasterKey();
        $context = $jobId . '|' . $userId;
        return hash_hmac('sha256', $context, $masterKey, true);
    }

    private function buildStoragePath(string $jobId, string $userId): string
    {
        $userHash = hash('sha256', $userId);
        $jobHash = hash('sha256', $jobId);
        return "encrypted-pdfs/{$userHash}/{$jobHash}.enc";
    }

    private function finalizeJob(string $jobId, string $path, string $userId): void
    {
        $manifest = [
            'job_id' => $jobId,
            'user_id' => $userId,
            'path' => $path,
            'completed_at' => time(),
            'checksum' => hash('sha256', $path . $userId . $jobId)
        ];
        
        $manifestPath = $this->buildManifestPath($jobId);
        $this->storage->write($manifestPath, json_encode($manifest));
    }

    private function buildManifestPath(string $jobId): string
    {
        return "manifests/" . hash('sha256', $jobId) . ".json";
    }

    public function retrievePdf(string $jobId, string $requestingUserId): string
    {
        $manifestPath = $this->buildManifestPath($jobId);
        $manifest = json_decode($this->storage->read($manifestPath), true);
        
        if (!$manifest || !hash_equals((string) $manifest['user_id'], $requestingUserId)) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Access denied');
        }
        
        $expectedChecksum = hash('sha256', $manifest['path'] . $requestingUserId . $jobId);
        if (!hash_equals($expectedChecksum, (string) $manifest['checksum'])) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Manifest integrity failure');
        }
        
        $encryptedContent = $this->storage->read($manifest['path']);
        $derivedKey = $this->deriveStorageKey($jobId, $requestingUserId);
        
        return $this->encryption->decrypt($encryptedContent, $derivedKey);
    }

    private function sanitizeHtml(string $html): string
    {
        // Remove script tags, event handlers, and dangerous elements
        $html = preg_replace('/<script\b[^>]*>.*?<\/script>/is', '', $html);
        // Match event handlers with single-quoted, double-quoted, or unquoted values (case-insensitive)
        $html = preg_replace('/\son\w+\s*=\s*(?:"[^"]*"|\'[^\']*\'|[^\s>]+)/i', '', $html);
        $html = preg_replace('/<(iframe|object|embed|applet|form)[^>]*>.*?<\/\1>/is', '', $html);
        return $html;
    }
}
